requirements.basis: Gross energy at the connection point is 8.8255+0.0929=8.9184 MWh over the 90% window. The 1 h auxiliary energy is fixed, so (4.600+0.0929)/8.9184 needs 47.4% SOC of window. The remaining 42.6% is split over both window ends, 21.3% each.
Cell safety limit: disconnect within 200 ms above 3.75 V, covering 3 daisy-chain scans, one control cycle and the contactor opening time.
5 s DC-bus-ready limit minus the 0.5 s start sequence before precharge.
Self-discharge spread at 35 C is 2.68% x 249 Ah = 6.67 Ah per month, to be removed in 4 h/day x 30 d = 120 h, giving 55.6 mA.
The fuse is too slow for the cell short-time limit (1 C = 314 A) below about 853 A (log-log crossover between 2C and 3C). The contactor must break up to there, and the fuse covers everything above.
After a fault the voltage is below 70% for 0.2 s plus 2.25 s of recovery (10% to 70% at 80%/3 s) = 2.45 s. Subtracting the supply's own 20 ms hold-up leaves 2.43 s.
All DC sides share one IT system through the unearthed LV winding. Capacitance is 34x1.23 + 5x45 + 34x2x40x0.17 nF = 267.3 uF, so one plant IMD is needed.
